notes.title: TED’S SUPER SCARY (AND SUPER SMOOTH) STEAM DECK UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234334/c43d5339721b8485cd0dab69a0cadea161810095.jpg"]^ Look a this handsome fella! I'M TED!



BOO!! HOLD ONTO YOUR CORN STALKS, BECAUSE... I’M TED! Halloween has come early this year, 'cause I’ve got another stack of freshly harvested patch notes for you! This time we’re talkin’ about performance, visuals, bug squashing, and ...STEAM DECK!

Let’s get into it before Dumitra's apparition gets back and does that mind-warping thing...



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234334/a5550905f3936e5a192f2f75aa909af67683a196.jpg"]^ Get outta here, Dollie! I don't care if you're lit like a Dario Argento Movie, I'm not turning my back on you! I know what you're like!


HIT THE DECK!!! BAHAHAHa
You got a Steam Deck? You like your games fast, smooth, and not a slideshow? GOOD NEWS!

The game now runs at 60fps on Medium settings on Steam Deck! ...Mostly!

Prefer crispy details? Try High settings at 30–40fps... Extra creepy, extra screen space reflection, extra detailed handsome scarecrows!

TED RECOMMENDS SETTING YOUR MAX FPS TO 60 (or 40 if you like high settings) IN YOUR STEAM DECK'S LITTLE SETTINGS THINGY IF YOU WANT IT TO FEEL EXTRA SILKY-SMOOTH!

Heck, if you've got an OLED Steam Deck you can even get 90fps outta this baby if Low settings don't bother ya.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234334/cbd7f5322fce5dfc3f3880065d575995492db2b2.jpg"]^ Look at that excellent, totally natural and highly realistic lighting. The kind only a spooky cornfield haunt can provide. BWAHAHAHA!


OUTSTANDING PERFORMANCE!
It’s not just the Steam Deck! We’ve cranked the creepy up and stomped the lag down on your PC too!

- Performance? ZOOM!

- Lighting? TED LIKES.

- Visuals? Sharper than my old pitchfork (RIP).

You can now run, scream, and cry in beautiful, panic-inducing HD. BAHAHAHA!!!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234334/4c48a4bd54af182028b985336f5282a4731ab40f.png"]^ Look at this inanimate fool! What can he even do, other than looking so pretty? I guess I'd use him and his pals to help me remember where I am. Not very talkative, though! Bah!


DIFFICULTY TWEAKS AND "OTHER" FIXES!
We heard your screams.. I mean-- feedback!

Better pacing! More suspense! More drama!

Slight difficulty rebalancing!

Random gameplay improvements!

Load times? ….Still working on it. ...but they’ve improved! I SWEAR ON MY SACK!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45234334/90a3580030e44df9904579ab81902473e63f254f.png"]^ Jack looking as huggable as ever. C'mere, big guy! I'M TED!!


BUGS? DEAD. (Mostly.)
I went out back with a shovel and took care of ‘em myself.

You might still find a few lurking, but I’M WATCHING. I’M TED.


MORE TO COME, MY LITTLE CHILDREN OF THE CORN...
Oh yeah. We’re not done. Not by a long shot. I’ll be back soon with even more updates, more fixes, more chaos.

And you’ll love it. Because...

I’M TED!

OK valve now can you verify it and put a little tick on in time for october, pretty please - I mean I'M TED!!

notes.title: Halfway To Halloween: Special Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45234334/8398bf67ce9f10dbe1e645b296a6af5b67b777cf.png
TED’S TOTALLY TERRIFYING UPDATE!

BOO! GUESS WHO’S HERE WITH AN UPDATE? IT’S ME, TED! I’M TED! AND THIS IS A BIG OL’ UPDATE JUST FOR YOU, MY FAVORITE SCREAMING VICTIMS—I MEAN, PLAYERS! BAHAHA! (I'm Ted.)

Now, listen up! Ted (That's me! Ted!) is here with some BIG, SPOOKY, SCARY news about your favorite endless cornfield nightmare! (That’s right, Terror in the Corn! Not to brag, but I know a thing or two about corn. Because I’m Ted.)

It might be the opposite end of the year, but here in Raven's Gulch it's Halloween all year, so buckle up, buttercup! Here's what's new for those who can't get enough:

🎃 A GHASTLY GRAPHICAL GLOW-UP!

Thanks to some fancy techno witchcraft (okay, okay, Unity 6), now it looks shinier, sharper, and even scarier, and you can now see my awesome enchanted pumpkin face (I'm Ted!) in higher definition than ever!

Blurry, smudgy filters? PFFT! Gone! Now everything’s clear as a cornfield on a cold, dead night! But don’t worry—it still has that classic grainy horror-flick look. It’s like watching an old scary movie, except… y’know... YOU’RE IN IT...With me! TED! (I'm Ted.)

Ultrawide support! That means MORE screen, MORE horror, and MORE CHANCES to spot something sneaking up on you. (Hint: It’s probably me. I'm Ted.) It’s IMMERSIVE. It’s TERRIFYING. IT’S TED. (I’M TED!)

🎃 BEING CURSED HAS NEVER BEEN SO CONVENIENT!

Being lost in an endless, haunted cornfield isn’t all bad, thanks to some handy-dandy quality-of-life changes to make your eternally doomed existence easier! I'm Ted!

Pause! Take a breather! SCREAM INTO YOUR PILLOW!
Guess what? You can pause now! You can even read notes in safety! Before, you had to speed-read like your life depended on it (because it did). But now? NOW YOU CAN TAKE YOUR TIME! THANK TED FOR THAT! (I’M TED!)

Run, run, run—FASTER!
You used to move like a lost grandma in a corn maze. NOW? You’ve got some ZOOM! Walking and running speeds have been increased! ...But not just for you. Hehehe. RUN FASTER, BUDDY. You can never escape ME! I’M TED!

Save Your Progress (For Weak Humans!)
Oh, you want to leave? And then come back like nothing happened? Fine, fine! If you quit properly through the menu, your progress will be saved. Listen, I get it. Some of you have weak little human nerves and can’t handle playing this in one sitting, so you’re welcome! I’M TED!

🎃 EVEN MORE SPOOKY STUFF!

- The monsters are smarter! (Like me, Ted! I'm Ted.)
- The animations are spookier! (No more slippy monster feet!)
- Corn stalks now react to enemies, not just you. (Including me, Ted!)
- A bunch more stuff that I forgot! (I'm Ted!)

Well... That’s it for now! Now get back in there and ENJOY YOUR TERROR! AND NEVER FORGET...

I’M TED!
